content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Allahabad University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 06-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Allahabad University recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow and Research Assistant positions at Allahabad University is September 6, 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Fellow and Research Assistant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Junior Research Fellow and Research Assistant positions at Allahabad University. One vacancy is for the Junior Research Fellow post and one for the Research Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MSc degree in Cognitive Science or a related discipline such as Neuroscience or Psychology to be eligible for these posts. Specific experience in computer-based behavioral experiments and neuroimaging is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow will receive a salary of Rs. 37000/- per month plus HRA, as per DST norms. This is a project-based position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The Research Assistant will receive a salary of Rs. 20000/- per month plus HRA, as per DST norms. This is also a project-based role.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an age limit for these positions. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any age-related details or relaxations.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for Allahabad University recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their application with updated CV and relevant supporting documents to the specified email addresses.

faq.question: Q8. Is NET qualification required for both posts?
faq.answer: No, the NET qualification is specifically required for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position. The Research Assistant position does not explicitly mention NET qualification as a requirement.

faq.question: Q9. What kind of experience is required for these research positions?
faq.answer: Candidates need experience in computer-based behavioral experiments, functional neuroimaging, fMRI data acquisition and analysis, and familiarity with platforms like E Prime, Psychopy, MATLAB, and R. Knowledge of conversational Hindi is also necessary.
